source.description: Where an imported survey came from, and what the reader found.

Survey.description: A survey in the standard format.

from_outside.description: The value comes from outside the survey (a panel, a link).

export_name.description: The column name in exports (Qualtrics DataExportTag).

response.description: Absent for an instruction, which is shown and never answered.

kind.description: A source question that is never simulated.

Question.description: A question, or an instruction when it has no response.

text.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

format.description: 'plain' (the default) or 'html' as exported by a platform.

TextContent.description: Text, kept with its line and paragraph breaks.

Template.description: Text with piped values, in order.

item.description: An option, statement or field ID, for fields that name one.

field.description: A column of the repeat table.

LoopRef.description: A value of the current repeat row: ${lm://Field/1}, ${lm://CurrentLoopNumber}, ${lm://TotalLoops}.

RandomRef.description: A random number drawn once per participant and place: ${rand://int/1:10}.

SourceRef.description: A piped expression of the source platform with no standard form, kept as written.

source.description: A web link, a data: address, or the path of a PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF file: absolute, or relative to the folder of the survey's JSON file.

ImageContent.description: An image shown with the question.

caption.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

corner.description: The label above the row labels.

TableContent.description: A table shown as stimulus (not a response grid): every cell keeps its row and column.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.
Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

additionalProperties.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

default.description: Options selected before the respondent answers.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

code.description: The value exported for this option (a recode); the ID when absent.

write_in.description: The option has a text box for the respondent's own words.

show_if.description: The option is shown only when this holds.

Option.description: An answer option, a scale point, a ranked item or an allocation item.

source.description: A web link, a data: address, or the path of a PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF file: absolute, or relative to the folder of the survey's JSON file.

Condition.description: A condition, as a tree. Combined conditions are read left to right.

ConditionGroup.description: All ('and') or any ('or') of several conditions.

option.description: The option ID (for a grid, a scale point's ID: selected when any statement got it).

loop.description: In a repeated block: every row ('all') or some row ('any').

description.description: How the source platform describes this condition.

DisplayCondition.description: Whether a question (or one of its options) was shown.

left.description: A variable, part of an answer, or a repeat value.

right.description: The value compared with; omitted for 'empty' and 'not_empty'.

Comparison.description: A comparison of a value with another.

ConstantCondition.description: Always true or always false ('If True' / 'If False').

qualtrics.description: The condition as the source platform wrote it.

SourceCondition.description: A condition with no standard form (a device, quota or location test), kept as written.

order.description: 'shuffle': a random order (of 'take' drawn at random, when set); 'random_reverse': reversed for a random half of participants; 'positions': each position pinned or drawn; 'source': a source platform setting with no standard form, kept and reported, not run.

take.description: ('shuffle') Show only this many, drawn at random.

consistent.description: ('random_reverse') Reverse every such question for the same participants.

positions.description: ('positions') One entry per shown position: a pinned option, or a draw.

shuffled.description: ('positions') The options drawn into 'shuffled' slots, in random order.

subset.description: ('positions') The options a 'subset' slot draws from.

qualtrics.description: ('source') The setting as the source platform wrote it.

Randomization.description: How options (or rows) are ordered for each participant.

Draw.description: A position filled by a draw.

not_applicable.description: An answer that is not a number.

NumberResponse.description: A number (typed, or on a slider, scale or stars).

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

mode.description: One answer per row, or one per row and column.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

default.description: The row's preset answer: a number for a number row, option IDs for a choice row.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

MatrixColumn.description: A column of a grid that asks one answer per cell.

field_response.description: The checks every field's text gets (length, format).

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

RankingResponse.description: A strict order of items, 1 the highest.

total.description: What the amounts add up to; 100 when absent.

min.description: The least one item may get.

max.description: The most one item may get.

AllocationResponse.description: An amount split across items that adds up to a total.

randomization.description: How each column's options are ordered.

GroupResponse.description: Several grids side by side, each column with its own statements and scale.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

response.description: The column: its statements and the answer each takes.

GroupField.description: One column of a side-by-side question.

best_label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

worst_label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

BestWorstResponse.description: The best and the worst of the items shown, two different ones.

SkipRule.description: After answering, jump ahead when a condition holds.

control.description: How the response is shown (it can change how the question is described to the model, never what is asked).

settings.description: Source settings that change nothing simulated, kept as read.

order.description: 'shuffle': the block's questions in a random order; 'source': a setting with no standard form, kept and reported, not run.

qualtrics.description: ('source') The setting as the source platform wrote it.

rows.description: One run of the block per row, in this order.

order.description: 'shuffle' runs the rows in a random order.

take.description: ('shuffle') Run only this many rows, drawn at random.

Repeat.description: The block runs once per row (Qualtrics Loop & Merge); its question IDs get the row ID in front (1_QID5).

additionalProperties.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

values.description: The row's values by field name; ${lm://Field/name} pipes one.

ConjointBlock.description: A choice-based conjoint: the engine draws each participant's profiles from the attribute levels and rules.

name.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

value.description: A number or price value, distinct from the label.

weight.description: Relative chance of drawing this level; 0 never draws it. Default 1.

label.description: ('generic') Label template; {letter} and {number} name the position. Default 'Option {letter}'.
Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

fixed_levels.description: Attribute ID to the level this alternative always has.

forbidden_profiles.description: Each map of attribute ID to level ID is a combination never shown in one profile.

allowed.description: 1 where the row level may go with the column level.

Applicability.description: Which levels of two attributes may appear together in one profile.

duplicates.description: Where two identical profiles may not appear. Default 'within_task'.

max_attempts.description: Draws tried per profile before the design is called infeasible. Default 1000.

assignment.description: ('supplied') How a participant gets a version.

instruction.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

layout.description: How a task shows its alternatives: a table with a column per alternative and a row per attribute ('table', the default), or each alternative with a line per attribute ('list').

scope.description: Draw the order once per participant, or once per task.

fixed_positions.description: ID to a 1-based position kept while the rest shuffle.

outside_option.description: An extra option such as 'None of these'.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

unit.description: Ask all tasks of the block in one model call, each with its own answer ('block', the default), or one task per call ('task').

MaxDiffBlock.description: A best/worst (MaxDiff) block: the engine draws each participant's item subsets.

label.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

duplicate_tasks.description: Whether a participant may see the same subset twice. Default 'forbid'.

versions.description: ('supplied') Each version's tasks, as lists of item IDs.

instruction.description: Text, or {"parts": [...]} when it pipes values.

Anchor.description: A follow-up after each task about the same items (anchored MaxDiff).

FlowNode.description: A step of the survey flow.

value.description: The value set; text may pipe other values.

from_outside.description: The value comes from outside the survey (a panel, a link).

then.description: The steps run when the condition holds.

else.description: The steps run when it does not (decided before 'then' runs).

evenly.description: Balance the arms across participants (true, the default), or draw each participant's arms independently (false).
